artworks.title: Thinker (Le penseur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a person sitting on a bench. The individual is hunched over, their head resting on one hand which holds a long stick or staff. The other hand is placed on their knee. They have bald patches on their head and a beard covering their face. The person wears a long robe, with shading and folds. There is no jewelry visible. The background has a vertical, wooden texture, indicating a rustic or outdoor setting, with lines for shadows and depth.

artworks.title: Farm on the Hillside (La ferme sur le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two donkeys standing closely, partially obstructed by a tree to the left. In the background, there are mountains with jagged peaks. The style of the image is detailed etching with fine lines and hatches, typical of printmaking. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of brown. Shadows and highlights help to create texture and depth in the foliage and the donkeys.

artworks.title: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic outdoor scene depicting a figure collecting or chopping wood. The drawing shows a figure in a bent posture holding a tool, likely for cutting or gathering wood. Another figure is standing upright, holding a bundle of sticks or branches. The background includes more bundles of wood and what seems to be a tree trunk, giving context to the rural working environment. The lines are delicate and detailed, showing the texture of the wood and clothing folds. The composition is simple yet effective in conveying manual labor and the essence of the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Landscape with Storm (Paysage d'orage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene from a slightly elevated vantage point. Trees with dark foliage are shown in the foreground with thick, layered etching strokes for texture. The landscape extends towards a horizon with no distinct features, except for rolling hills. The sky is filled with dynamic crosshatch strokes of varying density to suggest cloud movement. The scene is rendered in monochrome, primarily in shades of black and gray, creating a visual balance between the dark trees and light sky.

artworks.title: Returning with the Hay (Rentrant le foin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line and distant hills with small structures. In the foreground, two men are pushing a horse-drawn cart. The horse faces to the right, pulling the cart. The path leads to undulating hills with sparse vegetation and trees. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic sepia tone, resembling an etching. Fine brushstrokes create detailed textures for the trees and grass.

artworks.title: Return from the Fields (Le retour des champs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat, carrying a walking stick and a sack over his shoulder. He is on the left side of the scene, looking towards the rolling landscape to his right. The horizon is low with hills in the background. The detailed engraving uses fine lines to create textures for the man, foliage, and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of black and white. The background includes clouds and a textured sky.

artworks.title: Sinbad the Sailor (Sinbad le marin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a crouched position with his head resting in his right hand and his left hand holding a stick. He appears to have short hair and is dressed in a tunic and pants, barefoot. The environment around him appears to be minimal, possibly representing a rocky or earthy surface. The background is plain, with cross-hatched lines suggesting texture or shading.

artworks.title: Sinbad the Sailor (Sinbad le marin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a person seated on rocky ground. The person is hunched over, with their head resting on their left hand and their body leaning against a large rock. The person's facial features are not clearly visible. They have short, tousled hair and are dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, trousers, and are barefoot. The person holds a stick in their right hand which is planted on the ground. The background features a textured and slightly abstract landscape with linear patterns suggesting distant details like hills or clouds. The etching is monochromatic with fine lines conveying depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Chateau (Les ruines du chateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stone-built structure surrounded by bushes and trees. The horizon is low, hidden by foliage and rugged terrain. The technique features tight crosshatching for texture, light and shadow contrast. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and black. Detailed vegetation and a partially visible footpath are depicted in the foreground. The scene has a dense, atmospheric ambiance.

artworks.title: Fountain: Grotesque, Children and Basin (Une fountaine: Masque, enfants et bassin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a decorative fountain. The drawing shows a stone fountain with a grand face from which water cascades. Two putti are situated on either side of the face, seemingly interacting with the fountain. The fountain is surrounded by an arch made of stone blocks, adding a sense of depth and antiquity to the composition. The flowing water is depicted with animated, carved textures, while cross-hatching is used to enhance the three-dimensional effect of the stonework and figures. Foliage frames the scene on both sides of the fountain, suggesting a natural or garden setting.

artworks.title: Fountain: Grotesque, Children and Basin (Une fountaine: Masque, enfants et bassin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sculptural fountain. The drawing shows a stone fountain with an architectural niche housing a large sculpted face, with water flowing from its mouth. On either side of the face, two cherubic figures are interacting playfully with the sculpture. The fountain is surrounded by vegetation that partially frames the stone alcove. The artwork utilizes shading to convey texture and depth. The scene suggests a tranquil setting, possibly depicting a mythical or enchanted place.

artworks.title: Orphans (Les orphelins (?))
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people standing closely together in front of a large tree trunk. Their faces appear solemn, with most looking downward. The individuals wear simple head coverings or shawls, and their clothing is plain. The setting is a forest or wooded area, with tall tree trunks behind the group.

artworks.title: Harvesters Surprised by the Storm (Moissonneuses surprises par l'orage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures walking against a strong wind. The horizon is low, obscured by the figures and the wind-swept landscape. The artwork features loose, swirling lines that convey motion, with a primarily monochromatic color palette of brown ink on a beige surface. The figures are bent forward, one holding a tool, and trees are depicted with arching branches. In the distance, there are linear patterns suggesting plowed fields or pathways.

artworks.title: Fishing for Crayfish (Les pecheurs d'ecrevisses)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman next to a stream in a natural landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is in the upper third, separating the sky from distant hills and trees. The etching features detailed brushstrokes depicting trees, foliage, and plants. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light background. A woman is on the right side, observing a man reaching towards the water. Tall trees stand behind them, and in the distance, there are rolling hills, trees, and detailed water.

artworks.title: Geographer (Le geographe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a desk. He is hunched slightly forward, absorbed in his activities. His facial features include a prominent nose and a beard, and he has a bald head. He is wearing a long-sleeved garment. On the desk in front of him are various papers, a quill, a large open book, and a globe beside a stack of books. The wall behind is dark, and there is a window with a lattice design, through which light appears to be coming in.

artworks.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul at the Door of Bonhomme Misere (Saint Pierre et Saint Paula la port du Bonhomme Misere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together in what appears to be the entrance of a building. The man on the left is facing forward, but angled slightly towards the viewer, while the other two are turned to the side facing him. The man on the left has an elderly appearance with a long beard and is wearing a robe. The middle figure is wearing a cloth head covering and has short, smooth hair visible under the headpiece. The figure on the right also appears elderly with a full beard and hair. His robe is draped over his shoulders, and he seems to gesture with his hands beneath the fabric. Behind the figures, there is a ladder leaning against the wall, and shading that suggests a roof or overhang above them. A tree branch extends from the top right corner of the background.

artworks.title: Supper of the Poor (Le souper chez misere)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows four people sitting around a table. They are seated closely together, with their upper bodies visible. The people have distinctive facial features, and one has a beard. The group is illuminated by a central light source, possibly a candle on the table, casting shadows on their faces and hands. They are wearing simple, casual clothing with no visible accessories. One person is wearing a hat. The table is sparsely laid out with a few items. In the background, there is a wall and an object resembling a cluster of lights hanging above. The drawing style adds to the scene's atmosphere.

artworks.title: Encounter of the Moorish Horsemen (Rencontre de Cavaliers Maures)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses rearing up and facing each other. The drawing captures a dynamic scene featuring two horses mid-action. Their bodies are intertwined as they rear. The horse on the left is lighter in tone, while the horse on the right is darker. The drawing features fine lines and detailed shading, contributing to the depiction of the musculature and motion of the animals. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Gellius de Bouma
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Keppel
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated in a chair, positioned slightly turned to the side. He has one hand resting on his lap and the other holding a piece of fabric. His facial features include a white beard and mustache, heavy eyelids, and a gentle expression. He wears a cap and a long coat with detailed buttons, along with a pleated ruff around his neck. The background includes a table with papers, an inkwell, and a quill. The backdrop is dark and textured, creating depth to the portrait. No jewelry is visible, and the setting suggests a scholarly or stately environment.

artworks.title: Dance in the Country (La danse à la campagne)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman dancing closely together outdoors. The woman has her arm around the man's shoulder, leaning towards him with her eyes closed. She has long hair with flowers or ribbons and wears a flowing dress with decorative elements. The man holds her waist with one arm and their other hands are clasped. He wears a striped jacket and a hat that partially covers his face, revealing a bit of beard on his chin. The background features sketchy, textured vegetation.

artworks.title: Robert Abbot, Bishop of Salisbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man seated, holding an open book in his left hand. He has a long beard and mustache, wearing a distinct cap and robe typical of the Renaissance or early Baroque period. The background is plain with fine cross-hatching, and there are vertical studs on the chair. Engraved text identifies him as Robertus Abbatvs Epis: Sarum.

artworks.title: Domini Robertus, Episcopi Salisbury (Robert Abbot, Bishop of Salisbury)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. The individual is seated or positioned slightly forward and gazes directly at the viewer. He has a long beard and mustache, with sharp and distinct facial features. His hair is covered by a cap. The man is wearing a voluminous garment with a large collar and puffed sleeves. He holds a pair of spectacles or pince-nez in his hands, and before him is an open book. The background is decorated with ornate scrollwork and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Johann Adam Renner of Allmendingen
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is facing forward in a seated position, with his gaze directed slightly off to the side. The man has a round face with a prominent nose, a short beard, and a mustache. His hair is covered by a cap, snugly fitting over his head. He is dressed in traditional clerical clothing with a high, white collar and a dark, intricately designed garment with visible buttons. In front of him is a large coat of arms protected by a bishop's mitre, featuring detailed heraldic symbols. The background is an ornate, engraved frame with Latin text surrounding the portrait, and decorative elements including cherubs, swirls, and classical figures.

artworks.title: Joannes Adams
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the mid-chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has curly, short hair and a neatly shaped beard and mustache. He is wearing detailed clothing, featuring a high-collared shirt with lace and a jacket with decorated epaulettes. He is not visibly wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The background consists of engraved lines, adding depth to the portrait, and the entire composition is encased within an oval with a Latin inscription encircling it.
